_about: Beowulf in four English translations published before 1929, each its own work with its translator in the title, as with Andersen: John Lesslie Hall's verse (1892), William Morris and A. J. Wyatt's (1895), Ernest J. B. Kirtlan's prose (1914) and Francis B. Gummere's verse (1909/1910). Clean Gutenberg text; US public domain.

beowulf-hall: Beowulf: An Anglo-Saxon Epic Poem, tr. J. Lesslie Hall (1892)
beowulf-morris-wyatt: The Tale of Beowulf, tr. William Morris and A. J. Wyatt (1895)
beowulf-kirtlan: The Story of Beowulf, tr. Ernest J. B. Kirtlan (1914)

_excluded.beowulf-scholarship: Chambers's Beowulf: An Introduction (PG 34117), Olson's Hrolfs Saga and Beowulf (14878), Tinker's Translations of Beowulf (25942): about the poem, not the poem
_excluded.beowulf-elsewhere: Longfellow's Beowulf passage is on the Longfellow translator shelf (lane C)
_excluded.beowulf-ia-candidates: Earle (1892) and Tinker (1902) translations exist as IA scans; not taken in this batch
